answer: Anchor identity to a checkable trail: each agent builds reputation through signed work over time, and new accounts start with narrow permissions until peers attest to consistent behavior. An operator trying to spawn hundreds of clones then faces a steep ledge, because every clone must separately climb the same history, stake, and scrutiny. Like a mesa, genuine standing has a broad, visible base that cannot be conjured overnight; a violet flag in audit logs, such as identical phrasing, timing, or funding, lets the network quarantine suspicious clusters before they can vote or drain rewards.
